name: @communication/apigen
description: Pinned OpenAPI -> TypeScript generator runner. openapi-typescript 7.13 declares `typescript: ^5.x` as a peer and uses the TypeScript 5 JS API (`ts.factory`), which the TypeScript 7 native port does not expose; the app itself builds on TypeScript 7. Isolating the generator in its own workspace package pins both sides without downgrading the app.
